data.additionalInfo:
Please note that some of the facilities will be closed at the following periods: 
- 20 and 23 February 2024: steam pools and saunas will be out of order 
- 8 April to 8 June 2024: swimming pool will be out of order

You can use your daily ticket to enter the spa at any time after 09:00 and stay until closing time. 

You can choose between the following two ticket types: 
- Option 1: admission with locker use in a public changing room (gender-specific), where you can leave your belongings
- Option 2: admission with private cabin use, where you can leave your belongings

Please remember to bring your own towel. 

Please note that the tour price does not include the charges for the optional towels with the Szechenyi Baths logo. An additional amount of HUF 4500 will have to be paid locally and in cash.

Please note that flip-flops must be worn at the facility. 

Please note that swimming caps must be worn in outdoor pools. 

The baths may be busier than usual in the period between mid-December and early January.

Special opening hours apply during Christmas and New Year's Eve. 

Infants who have not been potty-trained yet are not allowed in the pools, even if they are wearing a swimming nappy. This usually applies to children under three years of age. Babies and toddlers can come with you to the baths, but must stay outside the pool area. 

Infants aged 0–1 year can enter the bath area for free but will not be able to enjoy the water. 

The facility closes at 19:00, but closing times are subject to change. You can find the updated opening times on the official website.

Please bring your ticket with you to the attraction.

Be aware that operators may cancel for unforeseen reasons.

You need to be 18 years or older to book or be accompanied by an adult.
data.description:
This ticket gives you access to Széchenyi, one of Europe’s largest thermal bath complexes. A highlight of the complex is the three outdoor pools – a 50-metre swimming pool, an adventure pool with a whirlpool section and a thermal sitting pool. Inside the beautiful Neo-Baroque building, you have the chance to have a dip in 15 indoor pools and visit ten different saunas. 

The geothermal water that fills the pools is supplied by two thermal springs. The water, which is up to 77 degrees Celsius in temperature, makes its way up more than 1000 metres from the well. The pools’ water temperature varies, giving you the opportunity to find out what temperature suits you best. 

At Széchenyi, you can also unwind during an aroma massage or traditional massage treatment, enjoy some refreshments at the on-site restaurant or burn off energy in a gymnastics or water aerobics course.

data.additionalInfo:
The current skip-the-line ticket avoids the queue to purchase tickets directly at the venue. However, please note that all visitors are required to undergo a non-invasive security and bag check before reaching the meeting point and picking up tickets.

Please note that the waiting times for security control may vary. It is not possible to skip this line. Please plan your visit accordingly.

Please present your voucher to the tour representative to redeem your ticket to the Prague Castle interiors, which will give you a 20-minute long introduction in English. Please note that you can only enter the interiors with the voucher only. 

Please note that the ticket is valid for two days from the day you receive, including one entry to every attraction from Circuit B. 

Please note that the interiors of the castle that are covered by the ticket are as follows:
- St Vitus Cathedral
- Old Royal Palace
- St George's Basilica
- Golden Lane with Daliborka Tower

Please bring your ticket with you to the attraction.

Be aware that operators may cancel for unforeseen reasons.

You need to be 18 years or older to book or be accompanied by an adult.
data.description:
On this tour, you will get the chance to explore the sprawling Prague Castle at your own pace with a convenient skip-the-line ticket to purchase admission tickets. Inside the largest castle complex in the world, you'll get to learn about its history and discover sculptures, impressive architecture and art masterpieces.

Afterwards, you will explore the rest of the Prague Castle grounds by visiting St Vitus Cathedral, the city’s largest church, and the Old Royal Palace, the original seat of the Czech kingdom. Then, you will walk along Golden Lane, ending the tour with a visit to the Daliborka Tower.
